claims.claim_text: Officer Pham was driving the patrol vehicle and I was seated in the front passenger seat.
I located an occupied gray 2006 Ford Focus parked in a marked parking stall facing south.
I observed three additional occupants: W-1 in the front passenger seat and W-2 in the left rear seat.
I observed the subject's right hand was bandaged.
The subject repeatedly moved his left hand toward the center console, his waistband, and the area of his left leg.
W-2 was seated on the asphalt behind the right rear bumper of the Ford Focus.
The right rear tire ran over W-2's handcuffed hands.
W-2 was then struck by the open passenger door and front left tire.
I fired three times and Officer Pham fired twice.
The left rear bumper of the Ford Focus struck the right front bumper of our parked police vehicle.
Officer Pham fired three additional times through the windshield. I fired once toward the subject from the driver side.
A Hellcat .380 semi-automatic handgun was located in the right pocket of the subject's jacket.
The handgun contained a loaded magazine with one round in the chamber.
I observed the subject seated in the driver seat with his head slumped forward on the steering wheel.
Officers provided CPR until Costa Mesa Fire Department paramedics arrived.
